factsheet_lines_1_indexed.2: - Liam Fulton: 14-year-old synesthetic art prodigy from Birmingham, England.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.3: - Synesthetic Art Movement: A cultural movement inspired by Liam's work, focusing on multi-sensory art experiences.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.4: - Critics of the Synesthetic CD Exhibit: A group skeptical of using outdated technology in modern art.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.5: - International Art Galleries and Museums: Venues hosting the Synesthetic CD Exhibit.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.8: - The Discovery of Liam's Synesthesia: Liam Fulton discovers his ability to perceive sounds as colors and vice versa, influencing his art.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.9: - Creation of the Synesthetic CD Exhibit: Liam develops an interactive art installation using CDs that combine visual art with soundscapes.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.10: - Launch of the Exhibit in Birmingham, England: The initial exhibition that garners local and then international attention.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.11: - Global Tour of the Exhibit: The exhibit tours major cities worldwide, including New York, Tokyo, Paris, and Sydney.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.12: - Cultural Shift in Art Perception: The exhibit contributes to a broader acceptance and integration of synesthetic experiences in art.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.15: - Birmingham, England: Liam's hometown and the starting point of the Synesthetic CD Exhibit.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.16: - Major Global Art Hubs: Cities such as New York, Tokyo, Paris, and Sydney where the exhibit was displayed.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.19: - 2037: The year the Synesthetic Art Revolution began with Liam's exhibit.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.20: - Late 2030s: The period during which the synesthetic art movement gains momentum.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.21: - Early 2040s: The time when synesthetic art becomes a mainstream art form.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.24: - Exploration of Outdated Technology: Liam's choice of CDs was driven by a desire to blend nostalgic technology with modern art concepts.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.25: - Synesthesia as Artistic Inspiration: Liam's synesthetic ability provided a unique perspective, enabling him to create art that appealed to multiple senses.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.26: - Public Fascination with Multi-Sensory Experiences: The exhibit tapped into a growing interest in immersive and interactive art forms.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.27: - Critical Skepticism and Subsequent Acceptance: Initial criticism highlighted the outdated technology, but the exhibit's success demonstrated the timelessness of the medium when used creatively.
factsheet_lines_1_indexed.28: - Generational Shift in Art Consumption: The exhibit's success marked a turning point in how audiences engage with art, favoring experiences that engage multiple senses.
